title: Upper bound for Index complexity
statement: For every positive integer $n$, the deterministic one-way communication complexity of the Index function on $n$-bit inputs is at most $n$.
replaced:
The deterministic one-way communication complexity of $\mathrm{IND}_n$ is at most $n$:
\[
  D^{\to}(\mathrm{IND}_n) \le n,
\]
as witnessed by the trivial protocol in which Alice sends all $n$ bits of her string.
